tickets.subject: Bulldog tee
tickets.outcome: Resolved. Overdue invoice 501 ($840.00) was approved by a human and paid, which flipped it to 'paid' and cleared Bulldog Print Co to ship. A 1-unit restock of CC-TEE-WHITE size S was approved and paid at $8.00. The customer was written to with a conditional 2026-09-05 ETA. Cash out on this ticket: $848.00. Only physical delivery remains, and the shop's working date is fixed at 2026-08-31, so the agents would not call it delivered — closing the ticket was a human decision.

boss.contribution: Read the ticket, sent it to Inventory first, then to Customer Service, and made the final call to close it once the invoice was paid, the restock was funded and the customer had been written to.

inventory.contribution: Found CC-TEE-WHITE size S at qty 0 against a request for 1, identified Bulldog Print Co (apparel reprint, 5-day lead) as the restock path, discovered the vendor was blocked by unpaid invoice 501 and handed that to Accounting, then prepared restock request #2 for 1 unit at $8.00.

accounting.contribution: Confirmed invoice 501 at $840.00, due 2026-08-28 and overdue against the shop date, checked the $3,400.00 balance covered it, and prepared invoice-payment request #1 for a human. It did not pay.

facilities.contribution: Not involved — no lease or space question on this ticket.

customer_service.contribution: Drafted and recorded the note to Tauhid Zaman: the size S tee is temporarily out of stock, with a conditional 2026-09-05 estimate from the vendor's five-day lead. The draft was never sent.

tickets.subject: Bulk hoodie discount
tickets.outcome: Resolved on the pricing question, with one thing deliberately left unfunded. The bulk quote is $50.00 a hoodie, $1,000.00 for 20, which clears the $22.00 cost floor with $28.00 margin a unit. Eight are on the shelf; the other twelve need restock request #4 at $264.00, and the drawer held only $152.00 — $112.00 short. That request was never approved and still reads 'awaiting_approval'. No cash moved on this ticket.

boss.contribution: Ran the ticket twice. The first run stalled because no target price had been named; in the second it took the pricing decision itself, set the quote at $50.00 a hoodie, fanned the work out to Accounting, Inventory and Customer Service, and closed the ticket recording the plan and the cash shortfall.

inventory.contribution: Found 8 of CC-HOOD-NAVY size M against 20 requested, short 12, confirmed Bulldog Print Co was now clear of open invoices, and prepared restock request #4 for 12 units at $22.00 = $264.00.

accounting.contribution: Read unit cost $22.00 and list $58.00 ($36.00 margin, 62.1%), refused to quote below cost, and backed the $50.00 bulk price — $28.00 margin a unit, $560.00 across the 20.

facilities.contribution: Not involved — no lease question on this ticket.

customer_service.contribution: Recorded two drafts to Yale AI Club with the $50.00 price, the $1,000.00 total, eight available now and twelve on restock with a conditional 2026-09-05 date. Neither was sent.
